title: Silence and Interior
author: Dominic Okonkwo
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
